description: Narrow multiple-testing correction (Holm FWER; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR) for an EXPLICITLY defined hypothesis family. V1 supports only the two benchmarked procedures. The hypothesis-family definition and correction method are Director/user scientific decisions; the capability does NOT choose the family automatically and does NOT treat adjusted p-values as a substitute for defining the family. It does NOT silently mix Holm / Bonferroni / Hochberg / BH / BY or other procedures, and it does NOT claim that multiplicity correction establishes scientific validity.

references.name: Holm (1979) - A simple sequentially rejective multiple test procedure (Scand J Stat 6:65-70)
Benjamini & Hochberg (1995) - Controlling the false discovery rate (JRSS B 57(1):289-300)

methodology.note: V1 supports ONLY Holm (family-wise error rate) and Benjamini-Hochberg (false discovery rate), each with exact semantics, and only when definition-compatible across the demonstrated engines. Other procedures (Bonferroni, Hochberg, BY, etc.) are NOT claimed. The scientific family must be defined explicitly; raw p-values come from upstream estimates; adjusted p-values are derived output, not a replacement for family definition, and do not establish scientific validity. The capability is medium-risk with the existing medium-risk verification policy.

verification.evidence: Tested for the exact demonstrated scope: Holm (method='holm') and Benjamini-Hochberg (method='fdr_bh') adjustment of the two raw p-values programmatically derived from the accepted frozen Grunfeld panel-FE reghdfe result (value, capital; two-sided Student-t with df_r=9; raw p = 1.7727e-06, 3.7703e-05). Cross-engine agreement with R stats::p.adjust (holm/BH) exact. Deterministic artifact mapping (multiple_testing artifact + provenance) and adversarial coverage. NOT verified; NOT a claim of generic multiple-testing coverage; NOT a claim that correction establishes validity.

Tested for the exact demonstrated scope: stats::p.adjust(method='holm') and method='BH' on the same two raw p-values derived from the frozen Grunfeld panel-FE result (1.7727e-06, 3.7703e-05). Cross-engine agreement with statsmodels multipletests exact (holm/BH both [3.5453e-06, 3.7703e-05]). NOT verified; NOT a claim of generic multiple-testing coverage; NOT a claim that correction establishes validity.
